Regarding the sentiment analysis of the provided text:

The text contains a mix of English and Japanese. The English portion is a factual question with no inherent sentiment. The Japanese portion expresses a highly positive sentiment. The reviewer describes the game as "amazingly addictive" (驚くべき程度に中毒性があります), praises the graphics as "wonderful" (素晴らしく), and the storyline as "engaging" (魅力的). The statement "I spent a lot of time on it" further reinforces the positive engagement and enjoyment derived from the game. Overall, the emotive content is strongly positive.
